rows.en: ＊Amane＊＠０２８＿００９Helloooo!￥Hehe, I came to hang out!￥Can I come in?
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿０１０Hey, hey!￥How come your scores have￥been so good lately?
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿０１１Tell me your secret too!￥I won't tell anyone!!
Nothing special, really.
That's a secret.
Nothing special, really.
That's a secret.
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿０１２Whaaat! Seriously?￥You're amazing!＝＠０２８＿０１３Are you finally showing off￥the skills you've been hiding?
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿０１４No fair! You could at least￥give me a little hint!
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿０１５Didn't your mom ever teach you￥that helping each other matters?
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿０１６At first I thought it must be￥tough for you, not having a￥specialty, but...
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿０１７That wasn't true at all!￥Not having a weak spot￥actually makes you stronger!!
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿０１８If it's you passing me,￥I don't really mind that much.
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿０１９Maybe that's because I really,￥really like you!
Thanks, that's sweet.
Huh, is that right?
Thanks, I like you too.
Huh, is that right?
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿０２０I've gotta follow your￥example and work hard too!
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿０２１That's right!! So when you're￥giving it your all, I feel like￥I can push even harder too!
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿０２２I'm so proud to be friends￥with someone like you!＝＠０２８＿０２３I'll work even harder so you'll￥be proud of me too!
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿０２４Look forward to the next exam!￥Okay, see ya!
